purpose: Represent a customer account with a cents-based balance, providing validated debit and credit operations and a spend check used by payment flows.
responsibility: Primary: maintain and validate the customer's balance_cents, enabling spend checks and performing debit/credit under rules. Secondary: carry identity and profile attributes such as customer_id, email, and tier.
public_surface: dataclass construction: Customer(customer_id, email, balance_cents, tier)
mechanism: Maintains a cents-denominated balance and enforces validation rules: spend checks confirm amount_cents > 0 and sufficient balance; debit invokes the spend check before decrementing; credit requires a positive amount before incrementing. No external I/O is performed.
internal_structure: Mutation operation: debit(amount_cents) decrements balance_cents after validation
Mutation operation: credit(amount_cents) increments balance_cents with positive-amount check
lifecycle: Construct via dataclass with customer_id, email, balance_cents, tier
Use debit and credit to mutate monetary state
No explicit teardown or disposal behavior
state: balance_cents: mutable account balance in cents; read by can_spend; decremented by debit; incremented by credit
inputs: constructor inputs: customer_id, email, balance_cents, tier
outputs: can_spend returns bool indicating spend eligibility
debit returns None and reduces balance_cents
credit returns None and increases balance_cents
updated balance_cents persisted in instance state
key_interactions: debit and credit raise ValueError on invalid operations
side_effects: Raises ValueError on insufficient balance or non-positive credit
TypeError may propagate if amount_cents is not comparable to integers
errors: ValueError("customer has insufficient balance") from debit when not <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Customer.can_spend</SPL>(amount_cents)
ValueError("amount must be positive") from credit when amount_cents <= 0
TypeError from invalid amount comparisons during validation in credit
Exceptions from <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Customer.can_spend</SPL> propagate (none specified in evidence)
invariants: All debit and credit operations require amount_cents > 0
Debits only occur when balance_cents >= amount_cents
balance_cents remains non-negative when using provided operations
summary: Represent a customer account with a cents-based balance, providing validated debit and credit operations and a spend check used by payment flows.
